bounded_findings: CiNii catalogued late-Qing 畿輔叢書 print layout (10 lines x 22 characters) differs from first-party Xu-An/NCL 06270 catalog layout (9 lines x 18 characters); do not treat the late print as the same printing block or the damaged early rate glyph.

Tokyo and Tsukuba records identify two named holdings and two differently grouped target fascicles. Neither catalog proves their physical copies share a printing plate, nor supplies original L132 glyph, native source SHA, or page number.
HathiTrust's collection record is not itself an image-to-fascicle crosswalk; 403 on one linked volume is a local access observation, not proof that no other open target image exists.
Shuge's community index is a useful later-print locator, not an authenticated original-page reading or an independently dated early edition.
